framework_lessons: One regime can create correlated thesis risk.
assessment: This is the central framework statement and deserves separate scores for direction, magnitude, timing and causation. Bitcoin supplied a clear dated success. Inflation rose, but the assumed compulsory Treasury financing and low-yield ceiling failed; deficit magnitude and persistence were overstated. Gold and silver relative-performance checks were adverse. The author openly acknowledges value-rotation mistakes, while decade-level bets still require their original endpoints.
verification_limitations: Retrieved 2026-11-07; publication-date wording is not authenticated.

Public market series are available, but not every investment claim has a defined horizon or reconciled corporate-action-adjusted return. Unverified outcomes remain unscored; macro data use latest available vintages.
Historical book/model citations and chart pixels were not independently reconstructed.
